name: Concussion Scourge
description: Warm the palm with a thin thread of qi before dawn drill so the iron shell lies easy in the hand.

name: Facet Cap
description: Sight the target against the skyline so the arc of the throw is judged against open air.

name: Gust Shockwave
description: Release the shell with a silent flick and no shout so the foe hears nothing before the burst.

name: Casingdurance
description: Fold into a low crouch shaped like a basin so splinters pass over the bowed back.

name: Downpour Fuse
description: Loft a shell so high it vanishes into the glare and drops on the foe from straight above.

name: Murkcap
description: Throw a shell at the foe's feet so the blue-grey smoke drifts across his eyes and spoils his aim.

name: Indomitable Lever
description: Catch an enemy shell on the back of the glove and flick it aside to burst harmlessly.

name: Mayhem Detonate
description: Keep many shells in the air at once so the sky above the foe is full of falling iron.

name: Inexorable Shrapnel
description: Gather qi into a pale casing over a small group and hold it while shells fall round them.

name: Granite Kaboom
description: Send a great wheel of shells high over a line of foes so all the bursts fall in one breath.

name: Ghosting Fragmentation
description: Move along two banks of a stream in step with a partner so shells can cross from both sides.

name: Wary Pinring
description: Cut two fuses to the same measure with one stroke so both shells burst together.

name: Ferocious Spoon
description: Throw mirrored lobs from partners on either side of a lane to land on one point.

name: Casinginsight
description: Tap a partner's shoulder a set number of times to give the count without a word.

name: Granite Firecap
description: Dive into the cover the partner just left so the line is never left unwatched.

name: Punishing Casing
description: Burst shells along both banks of a lane in turn so the foe is caught between them.

name: Kaboomscourge
description: Light both partners' shells from one match in one motion and throw them as a pair.

name: Silt Powderchamber
description: Retreat down both banks while throwing back across the stream to keep pursuers from the crossing.

name: Kaboommettle
description: Lay bursts on both sides of a crossing so no foe can step into the lane without being struck.

name: Equipoise Powderchamber
description: Partners set shells with linked fuses so the bursts come in an order that closes each escape.

name: Corroding Sizzle Wrath
description: Both partners keep up a woven fall of shells from opposite banks until the foe's line cannot hold.

name: Kaboomvortex
description: Take a running start along a ridge and plant for the long pitch with the whole body behind it.

name: Gust Fragment
description: Open both arms wide before the throw and sweep the throwing arm through in one long arc.

name: Remnant Firecap
description: Fix a single distant mark and breathe slowly until the eye sees nothing else.

name: Rumble Shockwave
description: Pull qi through shoulder and arm in one wave to send the shell much farther than the arm alone.

name: Decimating Shrapnel
description: Skip the shell off a ridge top so it clears the crest and falls on the reverse slope.

name: Prescient Fuse
description: Read the rising air along a cliff and add or ease force in the throw to match it.

name: Charter Cap
description: Throw from a ridge in long arcs at intervals so a far valley floor is never safe.

name: Glint Spoon
description: Send a shell in a fine hard line through a small distant opening so it bursts in the room beyond.

name: Brutalizing Detonate
description: Send the shell down from a cliff top in one steep fall so it lands where no cover can turn it aside.

name: Verityspoon
description: Breathe in a smooth unbroken flow like running water so the throw has no hitch in it.

name: Charter Lever
description: Slide down a muddy bank on the heels after a throw to land under the lip.

name: Glint Pinring
description: Skim the shell low across still water so it comes ashore at the foe's feet.

name: Fragment Tenacity
description: Crouch in a reed bed so the stalks hide the thrower and soften flying splinters.

name: Glintlever
description: Throw from the middle of a ford with the weight kept on the upstream foot.

name: Gustsizzle
description: Turn the body in a slow eddy circle and lob from the far side so the foe cannot guess the line.

name: Silt Fragmentation
description: Throw a shell into a narrow rapid so its burst throws spray and iron on boats and men below.

name: Might Casing
description: Wade backward through a ford and throw at the bank to keep the pursuit from crossing.

name: Elevating Shrapnel
description: Keep the fuse dry in a hand held clear of the spray and test it by sound before throwing.

name: Blaze Fuse
description: Send shells in waves each broader than the last so the foe's ground is struck in swelling rhythm.

name: Mayhem Casing
description: Lay burst smoke where river mist already lies so the two mix into one cloud that hides every crossing.

name: Intentfuse
description: Pour an unbroken stream of shells onto a river bank so that no foe can hold it.

name: Might Kaboom
description: Approach a barred door in two files so one partner covers while the other hangs the shell.

name: Fragment Respite
description: Count the shell fuse against the thump of the partner's fist on the doorframe.

name: Aegisspoon
description: Brace the back against a beam so the blast of a breaking door spends itself on the wood.

name: Unsparing Detonate
description: Throw from the hinge side of a door so the shell goes through the opening as the leaf swings.

name: Vanishing Firecap
description: Lean back from the door at the moment of burst and keep both feet planted.

name: Siltsizzle
description: Burst shells at two doors of one hall in the same beat so the defenders are divided.

name: Silt Concussion
description: One track throws through the breach and the other rushes inside while the room is still ringing.

name: Murkfuse
description: Fill a corridor with smoke from both ends so defenders cannot tell which end the attack will come from.

name: Torrent Powderchamber
description: Hold a door leaf like a shield and sweep splinters back with it as the burst throws them.

name: Eviscerating Shockwave
description: Throw so a shell lands behind a barricade at the instant a partner's shell breaks its front.

name: Deedspoon
description: Seal a breached opening with a ring of shells so no defender can leave through it.

name: Leverhavoc
description: Throw ahead room by room as the partner advances so each breached door is already cleared.

name: Nova Kaboom
description: Both partners throw at once at one barred door so the two bursts break it and the hall behind.

name: Iron Spoon
description: Perch with a partner at two heights so every approach is watched from above and below.

name: Lever Insight
description: Give a short cry that the partner answers so each knows the other's place in the dark.

name: Rumble Cap
description: Both partners stoop together and throw in the same instant at different points.

name: Gustlever
description: Roll aside past the wing-tip of the partner's stance to clear the line of the next throw.

name: Ruinous Fragmentation
description: Throw so two falling arcs cross above the foe and burst in a tight pair.

name: Pinring Flash
description: Drop from a perch behind a fleeing foe and rise again to throw before he reaches cover.

name: Obdurate Lever
description: Spread the cloak like mantling wings over a partner while he lights the next shell.

name: Fuse Ruin
description: Both partners dive and throw in turn so the foe is struck from two heights without a pause.

name: Capmettle
description: Place shells at both ends of a lane while a partner watches from above so the lane becomes a closed field.

name: Rumble Concussion
description: Throw together from above so the shells land as one and burst with focused force on a hard target.

name: Shrapnel Premonition
description: Survey the floor of a basin from the rim to mark every hollow where men may shelter.

name: Sizzleblink
description: Walk the rim at a steady pace and count paces to place each throw.

name: Hoarfrost Firecap
description: Release downhill with the weight on the back foot so the shell rolls and bounds into the basin.

name: Indomitable Spoon
description: Lie flat on a ledge at the rim so only the throwing arm shows above the edge.

name: Waning Casing
description: Listen to the echo in the bowl to place where voices and footsteps gather.

name: Eviscerating Fragmentation
description: Burst a shell in the heart of the basin so splinters meet the men crowded to its sides.

name: Blazesizzle
description: Walk the rim and cast shells inward at spaced points so the bursts ring the basin.

name: Shockwave Devastation
description: Roll shells down the sides of the basin in turn to drive the foe toward its centre.

name: Intent Powderchamber
description: Keep shells falling around the lip of a basin so no one inside can climb out.

name: Remorseless Cap
description: Set shells in the low point of a basin so that any who gather there set them off together.

name: Corroding Blaze Kaboom
description: Time every shell of a rim crew to burst in the same instant so the whole basin is struck at once.
